name: Khajiit Lattice phase blessings
status: contract-ready; records not yet authored; manager script properties wired None-safe
designSource: Merged Lattice model: each of the 8 moon phases BELONGS to one of the five moon-path gods (cosmology, always shown). The presiding god's bonuses activate only once that god reaches Faithful (tier 2): +10% piety gain (script-side, shipped) plus ONE small stat blessing below. Cap rule per user direction 2026-06-10: max +5 flat or +5%. Anti-chore rule from PDV_RaceRewardBudgetLedger.md: phase stays amplification, never required scheduling.
moonCycle: Real Skyrim 24-day / 8-phase cycle (GameDaysPassed % 24), replicated from the Creation Kit GetCurrentMoonphase boundaries so the Lattice phase matches the moon the player sees in the sky. NOT the old abstract 28-day counter.

mgef.note: Prefer a sprint-cost surrogate consistent with existing Khenarthi tier rewards (sprint stamina drain reduction); pick the same AV the Khenarthi T2 record uses.

records.description: Khenarthi presides over these nights. The road asks a little less of you.
Azurah presides over these nights. Twilight gathers a little more readily in you.
Baan Dar presides over these nights. The pariah's luck keeps your feet under you.
Rajhin presides over these nights. Shadow sits a little closer to your shoulder.
Alkosh presides over the full moon. Order holds you a little more firmly together.

wiring.managerScriptState: Spell properties already declared in PDV__ManagerQuest.psc next to PDV_Bless_Khajiit_Lunar_T1; grant/removal owner is SyncKhajiitPhaseBlessing() (called from ProcessDawn), which keeps at most ONE phase blessing active: the presiding god's, only while that god is Faithful. None-safe until these records exist.
wiring.spellType: ability (constant, no cast), matching the T1 reward pattern
wiring.gating: No condition records needed: grant/removal is fully script-owned and re-synced at dawn (phase length ~3.5 game days).

balanceNotes: One blessing active at a time by construction; never stacks with itself across phases.
Stacks WITH the T1/T2/T3 reward of the same god by design (phase blessing is the substrate's voice, tier rewards are the god's); both are small.
Khenarthi/Azurah get two phase windows each (most reachable gods), Alkosh only the full moon (rare by design), Rajhin two dark windows, Baan Dar one.
Record in PDV_RaceEffectReviewLedger.md as a new Khajiit effect family before beta-feel claims.
authoringPath: Author via the established Mutagen race-reward tooling pattern (mirror PDV_Bless_Khajiit_Lunar_T1: SPEL ability + MGEF per record, then wire the five PDV__ManagerQuest properties). Requires Skyrim/CK to release PlayerDevotion_Framework.esp.
